origin: custom API demonstration; not official ZOJ or another online judge

domain.value: unsigned long long decimal, 0..18446744073709551615 on tested toolchain
domain.bounds_status: chosen protocol envelope, not official or measured hard limits

commands.I k v t: insert after k entries (0 <= k <= size)
commands.S k v: set value at valid 1-based k; preserve tag
commands.T k: toggle single tag at valid 1-based k
commands.Q l r t: GCD of entries with tag t in valid nonempty 1-based inclusive range; NONE iff no such entries

preconditions: All input valid; no signed values, reversal or malformed-input recovery
